payload.title: File:Polyglyphanodontia (tooth morphologies).png
payload.artist_html: J. Jiang, L.-P. Dong, X. Xu, A. Bi, & S. Evans
payload.credit_html: "A new polyglyphanodontian lizard from the Upper Cretaceous of southern China implies a complex evolutionary history of the clade"
payload.description_html: Tooth morphology of selected polyglyphanodontians (not to scale). (a,b) Xenodontolacerta fangi, a posteromedial dentary tooth in labial and occlusal views (CVEB20180206); (c,d) Xenodontolacerta fangi, a posterior dentary tooth in labial and occlusal views (CVEB20180206); (e) Tianyusaurus sp. maxillary teeth (NHMG9316), redrawn from Mo et al.; (f) Cherminsaurus kozlowskii, dentary teeth in lingual view (ZPAL MgR-III/24), redrawn from Sulimski; (g) Gilmoreteius gilmorei, dentary teeth in lingual view (ZPAL MgR-III/l7), redrawn from Sulimski; (h) Erdenetesaurus robinsonae, middle dentary teeth in lingual view (ZPAL MgR-III/19), redrawn from Sulimski; (i) Tchingisaurus multivagus, dentary teeth in labial view (PIN.3142/309), redrawn from Alifanov; (j) Pyramicephalosaurus cherminicus, dentary teeth in lingual view (IGM-3/130), redrawn from Gao & Norell; (k) Adamisaurus magnidentatus, occlusal view of the left maxillary teeth (IVPP V10054), redrawn from Tong; (l) Distortodon rhomboideus, maxillary teeth in occlusal view (MTM PAL2012.31.1), redrawn from Makadi; (m) Polyglyphanodon sternbergi, a posterior dentary tooth in occlusal and anterior views (OMNH 33460), redrawn from Nydam; (n) Peneteius aquilonius, broken maxillary teeth in occlusal view (UCMP 123325), redrawn from Nydam et al.; (o) Bicuspidon hogreli, posterior dentary teeth in occlusal view (MHNM.KK386), redrawn from Vullo & Rage.
